senses.gloss: m. (preced.) balance; only in כְּהֹ׳ (adv.) appropriately, reasonably, correspondingly.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 93:5">Gen. R. s. 93</cite> <he>כה׳ וכשורה עשה</he> he acted (according to balance and line) exactly right.

<cite ref="Taanit 4a:4">Taan. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>שאלו שלא כה׳</he> made an unreasonable demand (making their actions dependent on chance); <he>לשנים השיבו כה׳</he> two of them were answered properly (Providence favoring their ways); <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 60:1">Gen. R. s. 60</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 37:1">Lev. R. s. 37</cite>.

<cite ref="Yevamot 110a:6">Yeb. 110ᵃ</cite> <he>הוא עשה שלא כה׳ וכ׳</he> he acted improperly, therefore the court deals with him improperly (more strictly than the law would justify) and declares his marriage invalid; <cite ref="Bava Batra 48b">B. Bath. 48ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.
